data.long_meaning: The name Harlene is derived from the Hebrew words ‘har’, meaning ‘mountain’ or ‘rock’, and ‘el’, meaning ‘God’. This name signifies a strong and steadfast woman, one who is a dwelling place of God and a rock of support for others.
